_note: Argos Maps PRODUCT matrix (plan.md item 29). Source: our notes from argosatlas.com/en/pricing/ read in a normal browser on 2026-11-24 (public page; their map itself is behind a sign-in wall, so nothing here is guessed from inside it). Our own words, no copied text. 'argos' = what they say is free or paid. 'gev' = what the GEV map already does (UNVERIFIED unless marked, from README and layer names). 'us' = our site today. verdict = three tests (Helpful, Gain, HCU) plus the hard rules. status: edge (we are already better), parity (same), gap (they have it, we do not), skip (fails a test or a hard rule, reason given).
